mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.student_number, s.student_name, s.gender, s.major_id, u.account_status FROM batch_student_eligibility eligibility JOIN student s ON s.id = eligibility.student_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN bed_assignment assignment ON assignment.batch_id = eligibility.batch_id AND assignment.student_id = s.id AND assignment.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE eligibility.batch_id = #{batchId} AND eligibility.eligibility_status = 'ELIGIBLE' AND assignment.id IS NULL ORDER BY s.student_number, s.id

WITH scoped_rooms AS ( SELECT scope.room_id FROM batch_room_scope scope WHERE scope.batch_id = #{batchId} UNION SELECT room.id FROM batch_building_scope scope JOIN dormitory_floor floor ON floor.building_id = scope.building_id JOIN room ON room.floor_id = floor.id WHERE scope.batch_id = #{batchId} ), bed_scope_config AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS configured_count FROM batch_bed_scope WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ) SELECT bed.id AS bed_id, room.id AS room_id, room.gender_restriction AS gender, building.building_name, room.room_number, bed.bed_code, bed.position_index FROM scoped_rooms scoped JOIN room ON room.id = scoped.room_id JOIN dormitory_floor floor ON floor.id = room.floor_id JOIN dormitory_building building ON building.id = floor.building_id JOIN bed ON bed.room_id = room.id CROSS JOIN bed_scope_config config LEFT JOIN batch_bed_scope allowed ON allowed.batch_id = #{batchId} AND allowed.bed_id = bed.id LEFT JOIN bed_assignment assignment ON assignment.batch_id = #{batchId} AND assignment.bed_id = bed.id AND assignment.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE bed.operational_status = 'ENABLED' AND room.operational_status = 'ENABLED' AND assignment.id IS NULL AND (config.configured_count = 0 OR allowed.bed_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY room.id, bed.position_index, bed.id

SELECT team.id AS team_id, student.id AS student_id, student.student_number, student.student_name, student.gender, member.member_role, member.id AS member_order, CASE WHEN assignment.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS assigned FROM selection_team team JOIN selection_team_member member ON member.team_id = team.id JOIN student ON student.id = member.student_id LEFT JOIN bed_assignment assignment ON assignment.batch_id = team.batch_id AND assignment.student_id = student.id AND assignment.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE team.batch_id = #{batchId} AND team.team_status = 'LOCKED' AND member.member_status = 'LOCKED' ORDER BY team.id, member.member_role = 'LEADER' DESC, member.id
